Gross revenue comprises revenue from contracts with customers of R115,239 million (precious metals R100,296m, base metals R8,861m, other metals R3,715m, toll refining R2,367m) plus revenue from other sources (trading) of R1,159 million.
cost_of_sales: Cost of sales was R87,772 million for FY2025 (FY2024: R90,769 million), per the income statement (p.24) and Note 3 (p.31). Components: on-mine (mining and concentrating) costs R33,117m, smelting costs R6,789m, treatment and refining costs R6,193m, purchase of metals in concentrate/secondary/refined form R30,031m, depreciation R8,198m, a R3,607m reduction from an increase in metal inventories, a R644m reduction from a decrease in ore stockpiles, other costs excluded from inventory R6,407m, corporate-related costs R2,029m, operational-related costs R2,592m, royalties and carbon tax R1,786m.
operating_expenses: No single 'operating expenses' line; gross profit of R28,558 million flows into separately disclosed items (p.24): other income R2,735m, finance income R632m, fair value measurement losses R23m, share of loss from equity-accounted entities R540m, provision for expected credit losses R581m, finance costs R1,209m, market development and promotional expenditure R1,230m, scrapping of capital WIP/PP&E R1,904m, and other expenditure R4,148m (Note 4, p.32), arriving at profit before tax of R22,290 million.
trade_receivables: Total current trade and other receivables were R4,095 million at 31 December 2025 (FY2024: R3,698 million), per the balance sheet (p.25) and Note 20 (p.41). Including R711 million non-current, total was R4,806 million; trade receivables specifically were R1,950 million.
trade_payables: Total current trade and other payables were R21,923 million at 31 December 2025 (FY2024: R23,438 million), per the balance sheet (p.25) and Note 27 (p.50). Trade payables specifically were R15,496 million, comprising a purchase-of-concentrate liability of R10,627m and other trade payables of R4,869m.
notes: CORRECTED FY2025 (replaces a prior entry that used the FY2024 file). Statements authorised for issue 23 February 2026, all figures from the '2025' column with FY2024 shown only as comparative. Valterra Platinum demerged from Anglo American plc effective 31 May 2025, affecting comparability of related-party costs, borrowings and cash balances between FY2025 and FY2024.

revenue: Vodacom Group's total revenue for FY2025 (year ended 31 March 2025) was R152,227 million, up from R150,594 million in FY2024, per the consolidated income statement (page 18).
cost_of_sales: Not a single disclosed line - as a telco, Vodacom does not present a 'cost of sales' figure. Instead the consolidated income statement (page 18) breaks FY2025 costs into: Direct expenses R59,340 million, Staff expenses R10,435 million, Publicity expenses R1,914 million, Net credit losses on financial assets R2,096 million, Other operating expenses R23,407 million, Depreciation and amortisation R21,934 million, and Impairment losses R34 million.
operating_expenses: No single aggregate 'Total expenses' line is presented. Summing all disclosed FY2025 expense lines (page 18) gives R119,160 million including D&A (R21,934 million); excluding D&A and impairment, the aggregate operating cost base is R97,192 million. Group EBITDA for FY2025 was R55,511 million (segment note, pages 39-40).
trade_receivables: Note 13 'Trade and other receivables' (page 56) discloses a specific 'Trade receivables' line of R17,674 million at 31 March 2025 (not separately split current/non-current). The broader 'Trade and other receivables' total was R28,536 million current and R4,747 million non-current per the balance sheet (page 20). Credit-risk-by-geography (Note 30.4.2.1, page 82) further splits FY2025 trade receivables as R12,085 million South Africa, R4,359 million Egypt, R1,210 million other international.
trade_payables: Note 20 'Trade and other payables' (page 68) discloses a specific 'Trade payables' line of R20,828 million at 31 March 2025. The broader 'Trade and other payables' total was R44,057 million current and R386 million non-current per the balance sheet (page 20).
notes: CORRECTED FY2025 (replaces a prior entry that used the FY2026 file). Confirmed genuine FY2025 data, audited by Ernst & Young Inc. (report dated 6 June 2025).
